');
const PH3_MATRIX_HR=[["COPY","OFFSET","SWING","QUANT","LENGTH","PATT","MIDI/UTIL","TEMPO"],["DELETE","INSERT","SONG","1","2","3","4","5"],["ERASE","TAPE","FILL","6","7","8","9","0"],["PLAY","STOP/CONTINUE","RECORD","< -","> +","VOICE","TUNE","MIX"],["TOM 1","TOM 2","TOM 3","TOM 4","RIDE","CRASH","PERC 1","PERC 2"],["KICK","SNARE","CLOSED HAT","MID HAT","OPEN HAT","CLAPS","PERC 3","PERC 4"]];
const PH3_MATRIX_SR=[["PRESET/USER","PATTERN/SONG","1","2","3","4","5","UP"],["RECORD SETUP","DRUM SET","6","7","8","9","0","DOWN"],["BACKUP","ERASE","PLAY","STOP","A","B","FILL","COPY"],["MIDI SETUP","TEMPO/PAGE UP","TOM 1","TOM 2","TOM 3","RIDE","CRASH","PERC 1"],["PERFORM/COMPOSE","TEMPO/PAGE DOWN","KICK","SNARE","CLOSED HAT","OPEN HAT","CLAPS","PERC 2"],["UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED","UNUSED"]];
const PH3_PAD_HR=new Set(['TOM 1','TOM 2','TOM 3','TOM 4','RIDE','CRASH','PERC 1','PERC 2','KICK','SNARE','CLOSED HAT','MID HAT','OPEN HAT','CLAPS','PERC 3','PERC 4']);
const PH3_PAD_SR=new Set(['TOM 1','TOM 2','TOM 3','RIDE','CRASH','PERC 1','KICK','SNARE','CLOSED HAT','OPEN HAT','CLAPS','PERC 2']);
const PH3={
 hr16:{key:'hr16',name:'HR-16',os:'v1.09',crc:'a9bdbf20',fw:PH3_FW_HR16,sound:PH3_SOUND_HR16,matrix:PH3_MATRIX_HR,pads:PH3_PAD_HR,lcdCols:16,hw:'hr',soundInfo:'U16 8e103536 + U15 82e9b78c'},
 hr16b:{key:'hr16b',name:'HR-16B',os:'v2.00',crc:'19cf0fce',fw:PH3_FW_HR16B,sound:PH3_SOUND_HR16B,matrix:PH3_MATRIX_HR,pads:PH3_PAD_HR,lcdCols:16,hw:'hr',soundInfo:'U16 11ca930e + U15 319746db'},
 sr16:{key:'sr16',name:'SR-16',os:'v1.04',crc:'d049af6e',fw:PH3_FW_SR16,sound:PH3_SOUND_SR16,matrix:PH3_MATRIX_SR,pads:PH3_PAD_SR,lcdCols:8,hw:'sr',soundInfo:'U6 6da96987 + U5 8bb25cfa'}
};
let activeMachine='hr16',activeCfg=PH3.hr16,ACTIVE_MATRIX=PH3_MATRIX_HR,ACTIVE_SOUND=PH3_SOUND_HR16;
const ph3Nvram={hr16:new Uint8Array(0x8000),hr16b:new Uint8Array(0x8000),sr16:new Uint8Array(0x8000)};
function ph3KbRead(){let d=0xff;for(let i=0;i<6;i++)if(((matrixSelect>>i)&1)===0)d&=columns[i];return d}
kbRead=ph3KbRead;
renderLCD=function(){const cols=activeCfg.lcdCols;for(const [id,base] of [['lcd0',0],['lcd1',0x40]]){let t='';for(let i=0;i<cols;i++){const c=lcdDD[base+i];t+=c>=32&&c<127?String.fromCharCode(c):' '}$(id).textContent=t.padEnd(cols,' ')}};
renderLEDs=function(){const all=document.querySelectorAll('.led');if(activeCfg.hw==='sr'){all.forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('on'));return}all.forEach((e,i)=>{let on;if(i===0)on=!!(ledByte&1);else on=!((ledByte>>i)&1);e.classList.toggle('on',on)})};
xread=function(a){a&=0xffff;if(a>=0x8000)return nvram[a-0x8000];if(activeCfg.hw==='sr'){if((a&0xff00)===0x0400)return ph3KbRead();return 0xff}if(a===0)return ph3KbRead();if(a===6||a===7)return lcdRead(a-6);return 0xff};
xwrite=function(a,v){a&=0xffff;v&=255;if(a>=0x8000){nvram[a-0x8000]=v;return}if(activeCfg.hw==='sr'){const h=a&0xff00;if(h===0x0000){dmWrite(v);return}if(h===0x0200){lcdWrite((matrixSelect>>7)&1,v);return}if(h===0x0300){matrixSelect=v;return}return}if(a===2){dmWrite(v);return}if(a===4){ledByte=v;renderLEDs();return}if(a===6||a===7){lcdWrite(a-6,v);return}if(a===8){matrixSelect=v;return}};
decodeVoice=function(ptr){if(pcmCache.has(activeMachine+':'+ptr))return pcmCache.get(activeMachine+':'+ptr);let pos=ptr>>>0,shift=8,out=[],guard=0;while(pos<ACTIVE_SOUND.length&&guard++<ACTIVE_SOUND.length){let ss=signed8(ACTIVE_SOUND[pos++]);if(ss===-128){let n=1;if(shift>0)shift--;while(pos<ACTIVE_SOUND.length&&signed8(ACTIVE_SOUND[pos])===-128){pos++;n++;if(n>=3){const f=Float32Array.from(out);pcmCache.set(activeMachine+':'+ptr,f);return f}}continue}out.push(-(ss*(1<<shift))/32768)}const f=Float32Array.from(out);pcmCache.set(activeMachine+':'+ptr,f);return f};
makeCPU=function(){cpu=new MCS51(activeCfg.fw,{portRead:(p,l)=>activeCfg.hw==='sr'?(p===1?0:(p===3?0xff:l)):(p===1?slider:(p===3?0xff:l)),xread,xwrite});dmBytes=[];lastCmd=null;cmdCount=0;lcdAddr=0;lcdEntryInc=true;lcdDD.fill(32);ledByte=0xff;matrixSelect=0xff;columns.fill(0xff);renderLCD();renderLEDs();$('cpuStat').textContent='BOOTING 80C31';$('cpuStat').className='warn'};
function ph3BuildUI(){const lr=$('ledrow'),ct=$('controls'),pd=$('pads');lr.innerHTML='';ct.innerHTML='';pd.innerHTML='';if(activeCfg.hw==='hr')ledNames.forEach(n=>{const e=document.createElement('span');e.className='led';e.textContent=n;lr.appendChild(e)});else {const e=document.createElement('span');e.className='led';e.textContent='SR-16 LCD STATUS SYMBOLS ARE FIRMWARE DRIVEN';lr.appendChild(e)}for(let c=0;c<ACTIVE_MATRIX.length;c++)for(let b=0;b<8;b++){const name=ACTIVE_MATRIX[c][b];if(!name||name==='UNUSED')continue;const e=document.createElement('button');e.className=activeCfg.pads.has(name)?'pad':'ctrl';e.textContent=name;e.onclick=()=>pressMatrix(c,b,e);(activeCfg.pads.has(name)?pd:ct).appendChild(e)}}
buildUI=ph3BuildUI;
pressMatrix=function(c,b,el){unlockAudio();const name=ACTIVE_MATRIX[c]?.[b];if(name&&activeCfg.pads.has(name))p2QueuePad(name);columns[c]&=~(1<<b);el&&el.classList.add('down');setTimeout(()=>{columns[c]|=(1<<b);el&&el.classList.remove('down')},85)};
const PH3_SR_ALIAS={'TOM 4':'TOM 3','MID HAT':'CLOSED HAT','PERC 3':'PERC 2','PERC 4':'PERC 2'};
p2Coord=function(name){let n=name;if(activeMachine==='sr16'&&PH3_SR_ALIAS[n])n=PH3_SR_ALIAS[n];for(let c=0;c<ACTIVE_MATRIX.length;c++){const b=ACTIVE_MATRIX[c].indexOf(n);if(b>=0)return[c,b]}return null};
function ph3UpdateShortcuts(){const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fwshortcut]')];const names=activeMachine==='sr16'?['DRUM SET','RECORD SETUP','MIDI SETUP']:['VOICE','TUNE','MIX'];btn.forEach((b,i)=>{b.dataset.fwshortcut=names[i];b.textContent=names[i]})}
function ph3SwitchMachine(key){if(!PH3[key])return;p2Stop();activeMachine=key;activeCfg=PH3[key];ACTIVE_MATRIX=activeCfg.matrix;ACTIVE_SOUND=activeCfg.sound;nvram=ph3Nvram[key];pcmCache.clear();document.body.dataset.fwmodel=key;document.querySelectorAll('.p2modelstrip button[data-machine]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('real',b.dataset.machine===key));$('machineModel').childNodes[0].nodeValue=activeCfg.name;$('machineOS').textContent='OS '+activeCfg.os;$('osStat').textContent=activeCfg.os.toUpperCase()+' CRC '+activeCfg.crc;const sb=$('slider');const box=sb.closest('.sliderbox');sb.disabled=activeCfg.hw==='sr';if(box&&box.firstChild)box.firstChild.nodeValue=activeCfg.hw==='sr'?'SR-16 DATA ENTRY USES UP/DOWN  ':'SELECT SLIDER ';const note=document.querySelector('.note');if(note)note.textContent=`Firmware owns ${activeCfg.name}: keypad scanning, LCD, NVRAM and DM3AG commands come from original OS ${activeCfg.os}. Sound ROMs: ${activeCfg.soundInfo}.`;$('debug').textContent=`CPU reset vector → real ${activeCfg.name} ${activeCfg.os} firmware`;ph3BuildUI();ph3UpdateShortcuts();makeCPU();lastFrame=performance.now();cycleDebt=0;running=true;p2PadQueue.length=0;const st=$('p2PatternStatus');if(st)st.textContent=`Pattern Studio ready • ${activeCfg.name} real firmware path`;p2UpdateDiag&&p2UpdateDiag()}
document.querySelectorAll('.p2modelstrip button[data-machine]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>ph3SwitchMachine(b.dataset.machine));
const ph3OldPlay=p2Play;p2Play=function(){const st=$('p2PatternStatus');ph3OldPlay();if(st&&p2Playing)st.textContent=(p2Current?`${p2Current.artist} — ${p2Current.title} — ${p2Current.section}`:'Custom pattern')+` • PLAYING THROUGH ${activeCfg.name} FIRMWARE`};
const ph3OldDiag=p2UpdateDiag;p2UpdateDiag=function(){if(ph3OldDiag)ph3OldDiag();const d=$('p2Diag');if(d)d.textContent=`${activeCfg.name} ${activeCfg.os} real 80C31 firmware • OS CRC ${activeCfg.crc} • DM3AG packets ${cmdCount} • PC $${cpu?cpu.pc.toString(16).padStart(4,'0').toUpperCase():'----'} • Sound: ${activeCfg.soundInfo}`};
ph3SwitchMachine('hr16');
</script>
</body></html>
